[[File:John marston gallery45.jpg|thumb|270px|[[John Marston]] taking aim]]
Listed below are the '''storyline missions''' in ''[[Red Dead Redemption]]''. The narrative of ''Red Dead Redemption'' spans three different territories and over 57 different missions which are separated in 4 chapters. Completing each unique mission tallies in the Missions Module of the [[Social Club]] interface and counts towards 100% completion.

==Notes==
*Although players may complete most Stranger missions at any time once they are available (plus the DLC missions), the continuity of ''RDR'' and ''Undead Nightmare'' indicates that all Stranger missions (except for "Remember My Family") happen before John's death. Thus, only "Remember My Family" (in ''RDR'') and "On a Pale Horse" (in ''UN'') explicitly occur after John's death.

==Trivia==
*In ''Undead Nightmare'', completing a side mission will earn the Achievement [[Strange Things are Afoot]].
*Bonnie is the only story character in the game for whom the player is given over five missions, with a total of seven.
*It is debated on whether "We Shall Be Together in Paradise" is a New Austin or a Nuevo Paraíso mission. However, it adds to the Nuevo Paraíso mission count in the stats when completed.
*As common with the series' naming of [[Characters in Redemption|characters]] and missions, many of them are named after people in the Bible, its books, and its verses. In Redemption, they are:
**Exodus 20:16 (You Shall Not Give False Testimony, Except For Profit)
**Galatians 6:2 (Bear One Another's Burdens)
**Job 5:7 (Man is Born Unto Trouble)
**Job 32:9 (Great Men are Not Always Wise)
**John 8:32 (And You Will Know The Truth, And The Truth Will Set You Free)
**Luke 15:11-32 (The Prodigal Son Returns)
**1 Corinthians 15:26 (The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed)
**Matthew 19:6 (Let No Man Put Asunder)
**Revelation 6:8 (On a Pale Horse)
